changes.designReview: TI TPS62903 table 8-4 lists this Murata part. Use manufacturer lands, not the oversized imported footprint. Current screen includes 20% initial tolerance, 30% bias reduction, an additional 10% temperature sensitivity, and 20% saturation-current margin. Winding loss increases. Closed-loop startup, load steps, fault response and physical temperature measurements remain open.

Retain 25 V X5R and the fast 220 nF capacitor beside H5. Two 10 uF +/-10% parts give an 18 uF nominal-tolerance minimum, above the original 22 uF +/-20% minimum of 17.6 uF. Samsung typical curves show less DC-bias loss for the 10 uF part around 3.3 V; this is not a guaranteed combined operating-capacitance bound. Added bulk capacitor and ground via remain on top. The trial third capacitor was removed after it interfered with existing SPI copper.
